meaning: A mobile phone that folds shut on a hinge. You flip it open to see the screen and the number buttons.
clues: It is a mobile phone that folds.
It has a hinge in the middle.
Closing it protects the screen and the buttons.
The number buttons sit on the bottom half, and the small screen is on the top half.
It has two words. The first is a word for turning something over.
assumes: A cordless phone is a home phone with no cord to the wall
A walkie-talkie is a handheld radio you press to talk
A satellite phone connects to satellites

decoys.meaning: A home phone with no cord to the wall. It talks by radio to a base.
A handheld radio you press to talk and release to listen.
A phone that connects to satellites instead of cell towers.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Snapping the phone shut to end a call felt great. You cannot slam a touch screen.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Today's version: a smartphone with a touch screen. Some newer smartphones fold too, so the old idea is back.
